name: Screen Crack
description: Every death blacks out part of your screen

screen-break.name: Screen Break
screen-break.description: Black out sections of the screen on death.

grid-cols.name: Grid Size
grid-cols.description:
How many pieces your screen splits into.
4 cols x 2 rows = 1/8 gone per death
8 cols x 4 rows = 1/32 gone per death (default)
16 cols x 8 rows = 1/128 gone per death

fps-penalty.name: FPS Penalty
fps-penalty.description: Reduce FPS cap on each death

fps-drop.name: FPS Drop Per Death
fps-drop.description: How many FPS to subtract each death (lowest 10 fps)

gravity-drop.name: Gravity Drop Per Death
gravity-drop.description: How much gravity decreases per death
